updates.title: Launcher 2.2.2 — Play reliability fix
updates.body: Fixed the Windows issue where clicking Play could close the launcher with nothing opening. The client now starts reliably on more machines (removed a graphics flag that crashed some GPU drivers), writes its own log file, and if a launch ever fails it now shows the real error instead of closing silently. Fresh installs get this automatically; if your launcher doesn't auto-update, grab the latest from the download channel.

updates.title: Oasis 2.0 — New OSRS RuneLite Base
updates.body: Oasis has made the jump from the old OasisPS base onto a modern Old School RuneScape foundation (rev 240) running a custom RuneLite client. It's a huge upgrade — a smoother, up-to-date client with RuneLite's quality-of-life built in, and a far stronger, more maintainable base for everything we build next. Custom content is being ported onto the new base now — big things ahead.

updates.title: Launcher v1.0.2
updates.body: The client now always shows as 'Oasis Client' in the Windows taskbar, and the launcher starts more reliably.
